ownership: Official Texas Active Franchise Taxpayers administrative records published by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts through the State of Texas Open Data Portal
license_status: The dataset catalog license is null/unreported. Texas portal and agency policy provide general public-domain/open-data reuse evidence, but broader record-level or aggregate publication still requires an explicit dataset governance decision.
source_access: The connector itself uses only anonymous metadata and count endpoints. It may separately transform an operator-supplied CSV/CSV.GZ/JSONL/JSONL.GZ file already placed inside datahub after exact acknowledgement and a fresh matching-count preflight. It does not automate the public CSV transfer or authenticated SIFT monthly-file transfer.
allowed_use: read-only retrieval of exact official dataset metadata
read-only count(*) query that returns no taxpayer records
immutable local retention of metadata/count preflight receipts
schema-drift and scale assessment before a separately authorized acquisition

after exact offline-build acknowledgement and a fresh preflight: local-review-only normalization of an operator-supplied exact-18-field file into provisional organization and administrative-address evidence
with a separately verified corrected Texas active-sales-tax dependency: exact taxpayer-number reconciliation only
internal aggregate quality and administrative-ZIP evidence for governance review
prohibited_use: requesting taxpayer rows through this connector or automating either bulk-download route
initiating a large acquisition without the exact operator acknowledgement and a separately implemented acquisition workflow
representing a taxpayer administrative address as a physical site, storefront, service location, or geocoded operating location
creating business-entity geometry or latitude/longitude from an administrative taxpayer address
representing franchise-tax, SOS, exemption, or right-to-transact fields as independent proof of current business operation
automatically reconciling records by name, address, SOS/COA number, NAICS, or fuzzy similarity
joining ZIP5 and ZIP+4 into one canonical postal field
treating the anomalous _621111 source field name as a literal NAICS value rather than preserving and validating its NAICS Code label
record-level redistribution before an explicit license and privacy determination

publishing a staging manifest, writing current.json, adding this source to the business registry, coverage views, completeness measures, or Heatmap Builder without a separate governance admission and postal-cutover decision
attribution: Source: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts, Active Franchise Taxpayers, via data.texas.gov.
retention: Retain immutable metadata/count preflight receipts. Explicitly approved offline artifacts remain local, versioned, and confined to a collision-safe .staging run; source and quarantine are internal and normalized records remain local-review-only.
redistribution: The catalog license is null/unreported. Do not redistribute taxpayer-level source or normalized records; both remain internal or local-review-only until an explicit source-rights and privacy review authorizes a different policy.
personal_data_handling: Taxpayer names and administrative addresses can identify natural persons or residences. The connector does not acquire rows. For an operator-supplied offline file, selected source rows remain internal; normalized ES, IS, PI, PZ, S, and TR records withhold address, city, state, ZIP5, postal_code, ZIP+4, source postcode, and county. All other normalized records remain local-review-only and preserve administrative-address semantics.
